description: The Y2K windowing intrinsic trio FUNCTION YEAR-TO-YYYY (ISO 15.100) / DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD (15.23) / DAY-TO-YYYYDDD (15.25). LIVE (P11 Step 5): ONE windowing core (CobolDate.YearToYyyy) the composite pair delegates to (15.23.4 r1 / 15.25.4 r1 by-reference definitions) - the window is ALWAYS 100 years ending at maximum-year = argument-2 + argument-3 (argument-2 a SIGNED offset, default 50; argument-3 defaults to the EXECUTION-time year via the injectable RunUnit.Clock). All three are 2002 introductions; below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502). (SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT was split OUT of this row 2026-08-08: it is a 2014 introduction per the WG4 CD 1.2 Annex D.2 new-function list - kb/Work R28 - and carries its own row seconds-past-midnight-2014.)
display: FUNCTION YEAR-TO-YYYY / DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD / DAY-TO-YYYYDDD (Y2K windowing trio)
vcr: M2 catalog date/time additions; 2002 introduction (the Y2K windowing amendment; absent from the 1989 Intrinsic Function Module set). SPM split to its own 2014 row per kb/Work R28.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMDATEWIN.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 D8 PIC 9(8).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE D8 = FUNCTION YEAR-TO-YYYY(4, 23, 1995)
    COMPUTE D8 = FUNCTION DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD(851003, 10, 2002)
    COMPUTE D8 = FUNCTION DAY-TO-YYYYDDD(10004, 20, 2002)
    DISPLAY D8
    STOP RUN.
